title: Signature envelope (catalog.sig / catalog.sig-shaped *.sig / .review.json.sig)
description: Unchanged from the legacy skill-hub: exactly keyID plus base64 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the exact payload bytes. Production keyID is 'official-2026-09' (pinned in the app trust root; the private key is never in this repository). 'fixture-only-2026-10' is a deterministic public-seed test identity that can never be a trust root.
